The only logs present are package-manager logs (`/var/log/apt`, `/var/log/dpkg.log`, `/var/log/alternatives.log`), which reflect container image build/maintenance activity, not security events.

### Recommendation

To run these checks, point me at the actual host instead of the container, e.g. on a real Linux server run:
```
journalctl -u ssh -u sudo --since "7 days ago"
last -F | head -50          # successful logins
sudo lastb | head -50       # failed logins (needs /var/log/btmp)
sudo grep "Failed password" /var/log/auth.log
sudo cat /var/log/sudo.log 2>/dev/null
```
Alternatively, if you want a specific log file analyzed, paste its contents or mount the host's `/var/log` into a container and I'll review it directly.

**No suspicious activity or security concerns can be reported for this target because no security-relevant logging is occurring here.**
